facts.title: dilled potato and pickled cucumber salad
ingredients: 2 1-pound English (also sold as hothouse or seedless) cucumbers, very thinly sliced
A few branches plus 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill
3 1/4 pounds Yukon Gold potatoes (about 10 medium), unpeeled
1 cup very thinly sliced white onion
facts.yield_text: 8, or more as part of a spread
facts.author: Deb Perelman
